headline: Sensex Zooms 800 Points Intraday as Strong FII Inflows Fuel Market Surge

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Record foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows driving market momentum in November.
Favorable global cues and lower crude oil prices supporting market sentiment.
Banking sector rally led by Nifty Bank reaching a record high.
Strong intraday buying interest carrying Sensex and Nifty higher.
whatHappening: Sensex surged up to 800 points intraday while Nifty topped 25,500 before settling near 25,400.
Asian Paints extended gains while State Bank of India featured among top gainers.
Nifty Bank hit a fresh record high as Sensex closed up 427 points.
UBS noted that India's valuation premium faces tests from slower economic growth and tight rates.
summary:
Indian stock markets surged strongly today with Sensex gaining up to 800 points intraday and Nifty Bank hitting a record high.
The rally is primarily supported by record foreign institutional investor inflows and positive momentum in key sectoral stocks.
Asian Paints and State Bank of India emerged as prominent gainers during the session.
